mt: REVELATION FIRST ON THE OVERVIEW — THE THREE CLAIMS BY NAME, THE ANCESTRY TEST, THE TWO MICROTESTS AT THEIR LOCI; ABSOLUTE PRIORITY STATED AS THE CLAIM, 'ALGORITHMIC UNFOLDING' ADDED
d: THE ARGUMENT ADDRESS FOR REVELATION FIRST, 2026-11-04: the ancestry test and the anomaly of the received order, then the three claims (absolute, corpus, generative), the Muratorian Fragment, the census and its two shared expressions (στέφανος τῆς ζωῆς at Rev 2:10 and Jas 1:12; work, toil, endurance at Rev 2:2 and 1 Thess 1:3), three offers, and three source cards.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the arguments, the Overview gives the test, the three claims and the article's two lexical results, with the authors, record and AXN; it presents each claim as a claim of the article.
findings: THE THREE CLAIMS NAMED, THE LADDER LOST. Absolute, corpus and generative priority are kept apart, but 'The Claim: The Book of Revelation was fully written and finalized before the earliest surviving Pauline letters' states as the article's claim what the article calls a priced hypothesis ('The chronological gate confronting the maximal claim is priced, not dissolved'); the gate is offered only as a follow-up ('The chronological gate prices mentioned regarding the Nero cipher and Gallio synchronism').

THE MICROTESTS AT THEIR LOCI. 'found uniquely in Revelation 2:10 and James 1:12' and 'appearing strictly in Revelation 2:2 and 1 Thessalonians 1:3' match the census; the hedges of the article (direction unresolved for the triad; the common-source audit) are dropped.
ONE PHRASE ADDED. 'a directional, algorithmic unfolding out of Revelation' is the Overview's; the article speaks of generative priority and arrows to be tested.
THE CARDS. Two Academia.edu postings of the article and the Revelation room of crimsonhexagonal.org; no alexanarch.org card, though the record is named.
analysis: An attributed summary that keeps the three claims and the two results, and loses the article's ladder: the hedged maximal claim is presented flat.
